GovernorBounds.description:
Limits the runtime adaptive quality governor may move within.

The governor escalates in this order when frame time exceeds budget:
raise ``lod_bias`` -> shrink cull distance -> raise foveation level. It
relaxes them again (in reverse) once there is headroom. These bounds keep
it from destroying image quality on a scene that simply cannot hit target.

max_lod_bias.description: Upper bound on the global LOD bias the governor may add.
max_lod_bias.title: Max Lod Bias

min_cull_distance_m.description: Governor will never pull the cull distance below this.
min_cull_distance_m.title: Min Cull Distance M

GovernorBounds.title: GovernorBounds

PerformanceTier.description:
How heavy the generated content is, relative to the device.

Derived deterministically from the target device plus the amount of GLB
content in the project (see :func:`derive_profile`). The tier only changes
DEFAULTS -- it never forbids content.
PerformanceTier.title: PerformanceTier

TargetDevice.description:
Which VR target the generated game is built and launched for.

* ``pcvr`` — Windows native ``.exe`` (Vulkan + Win32 OpenXR), run on the
  PC and viewed on the headset over Quest Link. The historical default.
* ``quest`` — a standalone Android APK (Vulkan + Android OpenXR loader,
  NativeActivity) installed and run locally on the Quest headset.

Stages 1-9 (BuildSpec .. scene compile, incl. codegen + worldgen) are
identical for both; only the build + launch stages branch on this value.
TargetDevice.title: TargetDevice

description:
Resolved per-project rendering budget, emitted into ``scene.json``.

Consumed by the C++ runtime (``ScenePerformance`` in ``ptv/scene/Scene.h``)
to configure MSAA, foveation, culling, LOD switching and the governor.

ai_tick_rates_hz.description: Behaviour update rate at the same three distance bands. An enemy across the arena does not need to re-decide 72 times a second.
ai_tick_rates_hz.title: Ai Tick Rates Hz

animation_lod_distances_m.description: [full_rate, half_rate, stop]. Characters nearer than the first are posed every frame, nearer than the second every other frame, then every fourth, and beyond the third not at all. Clips still advance at the right speed -- only the sampling gets coarser, which is invisible at distance.
animation_lod_distances_m.title: Animation Lod Distances M

cull_distance_m.description: Entities beyond this distance are skipped. Deliberately set effectively infinite for small scenes so a compact game still renders its whole environment.
cull_distance_m.title: Cull Distance M

evict_when_over_budget.description: Enable LRU mesh eviction once resident budget is hit.
evict_when_over_budget.title: Evict When Over Budget

frame_triangle_budget.description: Triangles allowed to be VISIBLE in one frame.
frame_triangle_budget.title: Frame Triangle Budget

lod_ratios.description: Triangle ratio of each LOD relative to the LOD0 budget.
lod_ratios.title: Lod Ratios

lod_switch_distances_m.description: Distance (metres) at which LOD1, LOD2, LOD3 take over. Length is one less than the LOD chain length.
lod_switch_distances_m.title: Lod Switch Distances M

max_animated_agents.description: Ceiling on simultaneously animated characters. The scene compiler clamps NPC spawn caps to this.
max_animated_agents.title: Max Animated Agents

resident_triangle_budget.description: Triangles allowed to be LOADED (GPU-resident) at once.
resident_triangle_budget.title: Resident Triangle Budget
